name: Spline
summary: Browser-based 3D design tool for building real-time interactive 3D scenes and shipping them to web, iOS and Android.
description: Free-tier web app for 3D modeling, animation and interactive scenes with real-time collaboration. It has layer-based materials, a material and audio library, timeline animation, physics and particles, an event system with variables, webhooks and APIs, and AI-assisted 3D generation; scenes can be remixed from a community example library and exported to web, iOS and Android. A companion canvas, Hana, covers interactive 2D UI design.
contains: free tier plus Hobby $12, Pro $25, Max $60 and Enterprise plans (per seat, annual billing)
modeling, real-time rendering and layer-based materials
timeline animation, physics, particles and game controls
event system, states, variables, webhooks and APIs
exports and embeds for web, iOS and Android
community scenes, templates and example library
academy video guides and written docs
